findings.message: Submit now builds the request with context.Background() instead of the caller's ctx, so cancellation and deadlines are ignored; requests can hang indefinitely or outlive the caller's deadline, defeating the documented contract (and any timeout/cancellation handling by callers). The doc comment was also changed to match this behavior rather than fixing it.
findings.suggestion: Revert to http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, ...) and restore the original doc comment; if a detached request is truly intended, make that explicit with a separate method/option and keep ctx honored by default.
